messages.subject: simkit 0.4.0 is tagged
messages.snippet: Hi all,  simkit 0.4.0 is tagged. As of #3318, tools/simkit has its own go.mod (module git.pellam.io/fleetd/tools/simkit) and fleetd consumes
messages.body:
Hi all,

simkit 0.4.0 is tagged. As of #3318, tools/simkit has its own go.mod (module git.pellam.io/fleetd/tools/simkit) and fleetd consumes it like any other dependency: it is required in fleetd's go.mod and vendored, so fleetd builds the vendored copy under vendor/, not tools/simkit on main. We cut simkit releases on our own cadence; fleetd picks them up through bump PRs that Platform reviews.

Nothing changes for people who call simkit; the import path is the same.

Odile (Sim Tools)
